text_simplified: Parents must teach their children their religious and moral rights from a young age. The text points to the importance of guiding children toward *birr* (righteousness) and obedience to Allah. It also mentions the story of the Prophet of Allah, Ibrahim (peace be upon him), in the *tarbiyah* (upbringing) of his son Ismail. The goal is to instill Islamic values in the hearts of children.
